items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember that George said he would publish your music

ctx.x: We went to his house in Brooklyn. No, it was on the west side of Columbus Street...
I remember that George said he would publish your music, and I was thinking, “Ahh, Tin Pan Alley” and that kind of... I thought it was wonderful. I didn’t realize that we just had to pay $10, and...
